title: Rabbi Yassa bar Acha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 5:1, where Rabbi Yose challenges him. Hyman says that without doubt the name should read Rabbi Yaakov bar Acha, as in the preceding line. He explains that the initials R-Y [ר״י] were written and became Rabbi Yassa.

notes.text: The initials ר״י and their mistaken expansion to Yassa are Hyman’s explanation; his “without doubt” is preserved rather than weakened or independently endorsed.
The consulted Yerushalmi first mentions Yaakov bar Acha and later explicitly has Yose address Yassa bar Acha. Hyman proposes the emendation and explains it through the initials.
